Introduction

Employee traits play an important role in influencing creativity; however, it remains unclear whether mindfulness- a dynamic and adaptive personal quality- facilitates creativity. Drawing on causal orientation theory and control theory, this study aims to develop a moderated mediation model that explains how and when employee mindfulness enhances creativity.

Methods

We conducted a three-wave, two-source field survey with 232 full-time employee-supervisor dyads in China. Established and validated scales were used to measure employee mindfulness, workplace curiosity, creativity, and performance feedback. We used the latent moderated structural equations (LMS) approach implemented in Mplus Version 8.3 to test the hypothesized relationships among the variables.

Results

Employee mindfulness significantly boosts creativity by stimulating workplace curiosity, and this indirect relationship is moderated by performance feedback. Specifically, the positive effect of mindfulness on curiosity is stronger when employees perceive higher levels of performance feedback, which subsequently leads to greater creativity.

Discussion

This study highlights the vital role of employee mindfulness in fostering creativity. By identifying curiosity as a key motivational mechanism and performance feedback as a crucial boundary condition, this work advances the literature on creativity, mindfulness, and curiosity in organizational settings.\", \"doi\": \"10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1789515\", \"pmid\": \"42088680\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13135918\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1789515\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepm…

WAKE✳︎ is infrastructure for durable, accountable work across interchangeable
models, runtimes, and people. Research is its first application. Its name asks
us to consider what remains after an interaction ends:

> A wave describes possibilities. A wake carries the consequences of what has occurred.

This is the starting image for the **Quantum Wake Function** metaphor. The
architecture gives that image a practical expression: work can leave an
inspectable history that survives the intelligence that produced it.

## Waves and wakes

Imagine a boat crossing a quiet lake. Its wake is the disturbance left by its
passage. The boat may be gone while that disturbance continues to spread,
interact with other disturbances, and affect another boat's passage.

A wake is both evidence of the past and an influence on the future.

The distinction concerns what we are looking at: a wave's form and propagation,
or a disturbance in relation to the passage that produced it. A wake contains
waves; ordinary water waves also have causes and consequences. The opening
sentence is a metaphor, not a physical classification of waves as possibilities
and wakes as facts. Nor does a water wake preserve a complete, permanent account
of its cause. WAKE's software record supplies deliberate persistence and
provenance that water does not.

## The quantum inspiration and its limits

In quantum mechanics, a wavefunction mathematically describes a quantum state.
It provides complex probability amplitudes from which measurement probabilities
can be calculated. For discrete outcomes in the chosen measurement basis, those
probabilities are the squared magnitudes of the corresponding amplitudes. It is
not an ordinary wave in water. See IBM's

For a first installation, follow [the simple setup guide](setup.md#1-local-docker-installation).
It covers download, Docker, credentials, inspection, research controls and recreation.
This page explains the operating contracts and retained compatibility launchers.

## Run one installation container

The current local path is one `wake` container, one web server, and twelve internal
worker processes called nodes. Three parents (`100.wake`, `200.wake`, `300.wake`)
each have three children. Nodes do not run their own web servers. The installation
controller starts, stops, and routes them; they cannot continue after it exits.
Each node retains its own governed SQLite record. The controller has no separate
writable group research database.

Prepare topics and provider settings, then build and launch from the repository:

```sh
test -f .env || cp .env.example .env
test -f research-topics.toml || cp example.research-topics.toml research-topics.toml
# Configure GEMINI_API_KEY if you intend to enable Gemini later.
# Edit your local research-topics.toml for this installation.
./scripts/wake_installation build
./scripts/wake_installation start
./scripts/wake_installation shell
wake-research --help
wake-research status
```

**Every container launch starts research stopped.** Inspection does not enable
research or Bob calls. The Console and shell are available first;
use `wake-research start` only after inspecting the installation and configuration.
The launcher neither pulls source nor switches branches. VS Code can attach to the
running `wake` container; `/workspace` is writable and the existing WAKE `.bashrc`
terminal prompt is retained.

See [the reusable kernel contract](kernel.md) for application ownership and the
non-research execution proof, and [installation boundaries](installations.md) for
independent records and runtime lifecycles. These remain inside this repository.

The local [improvement application](improvements.md) uses that same kernel contract
in an explicitly new experiment record. Captured public research informs code
proposals; it does not become writable research authority. Untrusted candidate
code runs only in restricted disposable containers, while the host scores its
outputs. An operator review receipt cannot apply code or grant release authority.

The [autonomous context lane](autonomous-context.md) is a separate WAKE application
policy on the existing per-node native authority. An installed capability permits
one selector-field change, gated by recomputed fixed-task and current-native-state
measurements. Proposal generation, adoption and rollback require no per-change
human review. Metadata events preserve research versions and history; candidate
data cannot replace the evaluator, widen permissions, modify code or create a
competing research store. Native replay owns the policy after restart.

> **Current specification.** This document explains why the present system is shaped this way: its trust boundary, durable record, governance model and known limits. Current local procedures belong in `standalone.md`; public mirror publishing belongs in `cloud.md`. Maintainer navigation, environment checks and reproducible validation guidance belong in `development.md`.

**WAKE✳︎** is infrastructure for continuity of accountable work, not continuity of a model instance. Its stable sequence is **Record → Context → Proposal → Governance → Transition → Receipt**.
